items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: On bass is Neal Miner. ... You put the band together?

ctx.x: Are there any tunes that are particular favorites of yours or recordings of yours that some . . . ?

That’s the most difficult thing. How do you choose your favorite song? I love Lush Life. I love – what I like to do is do almost a dramatic version of a song like Lush Life. I don’t change any of the notes. The Very Thought of You, that’s a beautiful song. Everything I sing, they’re favorites of mine. So there’s no way that I could say this is my favorite or – no. And it has to be different every time. It can’t be the same, because that’s boring, and one thing I don’t want to be or have to act like is that I’m…
You mentioned Georgia Brown earlier. She was another – go ahead.
